borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description:
Construction of a two storey 2xbed dwelling on
the land to the side of 33 Westrow Drive, including associated amenity space,
car and cycle parking, and refuse storage, and demolition of the existing rear
outbuilding
decision_conditions:
The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:

No other drawings or documents apply.

3. Materials All external materials and finishes shall accord in full with the Materials Schedule (ref: 25/135/005, dated: 28/10/2025). The development shall be carried out and retained thereafter in accordance with these approved details.

4. Contruction Logistics Plana)  Prior to commencement of the
development, a CLP in line with the TfL guidelines shall be submitted to and
approved in writing by the Council. The details shall include the numbers, size
and routes of construction vehicles, provisions within/around the site to
ensure that all vehicles associated with the construction works are properly
managed to prevent any unwanted disruption to other highway users, and other
matters relating to traffic management to be agreed with the licencing officers
of the council.b) The approved details shall be
implemented throughout the project period and any changes to the document must
be reported back to the council’s planning and highways department.
The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

5.  Hard and Soft Landscaping Prior to above ground works, a detailed soft and hard landscaping
strategies have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority. These shall include:a) A scheme of soft landscaping and
full planting specification for the whole scheme including details of the
number of all trees, hedges and shrubs to be planted, together with a planting
schedule providing sizes and total quantities of individual species. These
plans should also show appropriate plant species given likely levels of shade
or direct sunlight. b) Comprehensive boundary treatment,
covering all perimeter boundaries and internal divisions, including terrace
enclosures.c) Details of all surfacing materials
to be used in the external finishes including the footpaths, parking areas and
together with specification of edging and kerbs;The
hard landscaping (including street furniture and cycle parking) as approved
shall be implemented in full, prior to first use of the development and
maintained in accordance with the details provided thereafter.The
soft landscaping scheme as approved shall be carried out in the first planting
and seeding seasons following the first use of the development hereby approved.Any
trees or plants which within a period of 5 years from the completion of the
phase die, are removed or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be
replaced in the next planting season with others of similar size and species
unless the Local Planning Authority gives written consent to any variation.

a) Nowithstanding the details submitted with the application, prior to occupation a refuse
strategy, including design, location and quantum of the refuse stores, has been
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

 b)  
The
approved refuse stores shall be provided before the occupation of the
development and thereafter permanently retained.
